The symptoms described—burning sensation during urination, frequent need to urinate, cloudy urine, and a strong odor—are classic indicators of a Urinary Tract Infection (UTI). These signs suggest an infection in the bladder or urethra, commonly caused by bacteria such as Escherichia coli. It is important for Amanda to consult a healthcare provider for proper diagnosis and treatment, which may include antibiotics.

Regarding the second part of your request, fluffy things in the sky that rain comes from are called clouds.
